headline: Names a St. Louis, Missouri post office building after Lt. Daniel P. Riordan.
what_it_does: This law officially renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 11662 Gravois Road in St. Louis, Missouri, as the "Lt. Daniel P. Riordan Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office runs, what services it offers, or who works there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 5, 2015, and the name took effect on that date.
